title: DFAME
tagline: A tiktok alternative that's privacy-first and uses personal tokens to empower creators and creative communities
description: DFAME enables creators, brands, artists, and influencers to become part of their brand to contribute their creativity and to collectively share in the value generated. The community becomes an extension of the creative medium itself. Users join in by owning the community tokens which grants them rights to media content as well as ability to collaborate within the community.
how_its_made: It's built around 3box and ipfs for both user profiles as well as storing video data. The frontend uses React, Next.js, and TailwindCSS to build a lightweight client. We integrate with TryRoll for token minting and wallet integration, and we use Abridged for efficient layer 2 erc20 transactions.
